subject: Batch 1 GI integrated: 18/18 areas met both Steps; 280 items, 36 sections, 309 cards, 23 figures
body:
Batch 1 (system 10, Gastrointestinal) integrated at e10fdde. Pack data/content/gi-multisystem.

Counts: 18 level-3 areas, 22 chapters, 36 sections (one Step 1 + one Step 2 CK per area), 280 original items
(145 Step 1, 135 Step 2 CK, including 18 chart items and 18 two-item sequential sets), 309 cards, 23 original SVG figures.
Coverage (tools/coverage.py): all 18 GI areas met on both Steps — Step 1 171/158 target, Step 2 CK 168/149 (legacy + pack).

Checks: validate_content 0 errors (250 lint warnings, mostly L10/L05 heuristics; polishing pass planned), seed:convert fresh,
tests/seed 43 passed, local seed on a fresh loopback stack imports and re-import reports 0 changes, rendered every section and
a 1-in-7 + all chart/sequential item sample at iPad portrait, iPad landscape and phone 390 (227/227; Chromium — WebKit is not
installed in this container, so the WebKit matrix is CI's).
Self-review: independent sample of 133 items (incl. all chart/sequential) and all 36 sections against current guidelines:
0 zero-tolerance, 3 major + 12 minor, all fixed before integration (impossible ascitic chart values, a Barrett near-duplicate,
a borderline transfusion key; AFP with HCC surveillance, pertussis prophylaxis macrolide, post-ERCP NSAIDs for all, etc.).
Further reading: every section has >=1 StatPearls page resolved via NCBI E-utilities, plus the outline link; USPSTF CRC and CDC STI links where relevant.
Not done here: YouTube mapping (the mapper runs against the DB with the API key; will run on the local stack after batch 2).

Medical reviewer (S23-R) can start on ids s23d-*10*. Next: batch 2, system 16 (28 areas, drafted, in self-review).
